command.description: The rgxg command to execute: alternation, cidr, escape, range, help, version

patterns.description: List of patterns for the 'alternation' command. Each item is a string pattern.

omit_parentheses.description: Omit outer parentheses if any (-N flag)

cidr_block.description: CIDR block (IPv4 or IPv6) for the 'cidr' command

lower_case_ipv6.description: Match only IPv6 addresses with lower case letters (-l flag)

upper_case_ipv6.description: Match only IPv6 addresses with upper case letters (-U flag)

uncompressed_ipv6.description: Do not match IPv6 addresses with zero compression (-u flag)

mixed_notation_ipv6.description: Do not match IPv6 addresses in mixed notation (-s flag)

first.description: The first number in the range (required for 'range' command)

last.description: The last number in the range (optional for 'range' command; if omitted, matches >= first)

base.description: Number base for the 'range' command (2-32, default 10)

lower_case_letters.description: For bases > 10, match only lower case letters (-l flag in 'range')

upper_case_letters.description: For bases > 10, match only upper case letters (-U flag in 'range')

leading_zeros_exact.description: Only match numbers with leading zeros (-z flag in 'range')

leading_zeros_variable.description: Match numbers with a variable number of leading zeros (-Z flag in 'range')

min_length.description: Minimum length of matched numbers when using -z or -Z (-m flag in 'range')

input_string.description: String to escape for the 'escape' command
